subject: Request: Temporary Net-120 bridge for SunForge pilot (split PO + milestone invoicing)
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Temporary Net-120 bridge for SunForge pilot (split PO + milestone invoicing)

Team,

Heads up — SunForge (pilot customer, expected ARR ~$450k first 12 months) is asking for a one-time billing cadence exception to accommodate their procurement cycle. Details below: 

- Ask: Net-120 on their first two invoices (they will split into two POs to match internal budget windows), then move to quarterly invoicing thereafter.
- Rationale: They are a strategic pilot (healthcare vertical) and procurement cannot get the initial PO approved inside our standard Net-30 timeline. They insisted on a formal PO split and require an escrow / payment guarantee clause for the first two invoices.
- Tradeoffs: Increases DSO exposure for ~2 months; Sales is proposing a 1% early-pay discount if either of the first two invoices are paid within 30 days.
- Attachments: SunForge_PO_scan.pdf (scanned PO they can issue), SOW_SunForge_v3.docx.

Requesting exec sign-off for:
1) Approve Net-120 for invoices #1 and #2 only; invoices after that move to quarterly terms.
2) Cap Redwood exposure to $150k for the Net-120 period and require either escrow or a signed AP agreement.
3) Approve the 1% early-pay discount pilot tied to the first two invoices only.

If approved I will coordinate with Legal to get the escrow wording in the SOW and with CS to confirm milestone acceptance criteria.

Deal ID: DF-2026-089.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0126

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary Net-120 bridge for SunForge pilot (split PO + milestone invoicing)

Vivek —

Thanks for the summary. A few follow-ups from Finance: 

1) We need a concrete exposure cap number and confirmation that the two POs together do not exceed the cap. You requested $150k cap — please confirm how that maps to the two invoice amounts.
2) Escrow is acceptable for the first two invoices, but Legal will need the escrow template completed and signed prior to billing. Please route the signed PO + escrow confirmation to ap@redwood.ai.
3) The 1% early-pay discount is OK as a pilot, but Finance asks that we limit it to a single-instance (i.e., do not make it a standard term). Add a clause: "1% discount if payment received within 30 days for invoice 1 or 2 only."
4) We will need revenue recognition guidance from Accounting for the Net-120 period — I will loop in Accounting after we get legal confirmation.

If you can provide exact invoice amounts and confirm PO split by EOD tomorrow, I can draft the approval memo for Jonas.

-Monica
Monica Patel
Director, Finance Operations
monica.patel@redwood.ai

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:13:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary Net-120 bridge for SunForge pilot (split PO + milestone invoicing)

Monica —

Confirming details per your ask: 
- PO split: PO# SF-6731-A = $85,000 (covers setup + first milestone). PO# SF-6731-B = $65,000 (covers second milestone). Combined = $150,000 (matches proposed exposure cap).
- Proposed milestone billing: Invoice 1 (upon delivery of pilot environment + verification) = $85k; Invoice 2 (30 days after go-live acceptance) = $65k. After those two invoices, billing will move to quarterly invoices for usage/consumption.
- SunForge has agreed to sign the escrow addendum and the SOW redline with the early-pay discount clause as suggested. Attached: MAP_SunForge_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan).

I will push for signatures today and ask AP to send confirmation to ap@redwood.ai. If Legal needs anything else, please let me know and I'll prioritize.

Vivek

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 13:57:00 -0700
Subject: Approved (conditional): SunForge temporary Net-120 for first two invoices

Vivek / Monica —

I reviewed the exposure and rationale. Approve the requested exception with the following firm conditions: 

1) Net-120 approved for invoice 1 and invoice 2 only (no ongoing Net-120).
2) Exposure cap: $150,000 maximum; if invoices exceed that cap for any reason, billing must revert to Net-30 until additional executive approval is obtained.
3) Escrow or an AP confirmation email from ap@sunforge.io (with signed PO numbers) must be received and stored in the deal record before we send Invoice 1.
4) The 1% early-pay discount is approved for the two invoices only and must be explicitly time-boxed in the SOW (not part of standard T&Cs).
5) Legal to include a short credit-protection paragraph and to notify Accounting for revenue recognition treatment.

Marissa — please coordinate the actual approval memo and note the conditions above in the HubSpot deal. Monica — once we have the signed PO + escrow confirmation, please confirm and I'll sign the exec ticket.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
VP Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

Vivek —

Thanks for working through this. We can confirm the following:

- We will issue two PO numbers (SF-6731-A and SF-6731-B) and will send signed scans to ap@redwood.ai today.
- We agree to the escrow addendum and the 1% early-pay language for invoice 1 and 2 only.
- We will have Finance release an AP confirmation email that includes PO numbers and expected payment windows.

Appreciate the flexibility — looking forward to getting the pilot started.

Best,
